# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** 7  <sub>[v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025)</sub>
- **Role:** aspiring storekeeper  <sub>[v2 XIV A Danger Averted P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Davy Keith is characterized by a round head covered in fuzzy, curly yellow ringlets. He has a snub nose and a single dimple in one cheek, which gives him a comical, lopsided expression when he laughs.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)_

## Personality

Davy Keith is a young boy full of mischief, heedlessness, and forgetfulness. He possesses a lively and inquisitive curiosity, frequently asking questions about the world around him. He aspires to one day become a storekeeper so he can keep plenty of candy and bananas.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 IX A Question of Color P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031), +3 more_

## History

Davy Keith lost his father when he was a baby. After coming to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), he frequently engaged in misbehavior, such as snatching his sister Dora's cake, putting a toad in Marilla's bed, and locking [Dora](../character/dora.md) in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse before lying about it. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) disciplined him for eating forbidden jam, Davy and [Dora](../character/dora.md) were allowed to remain at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) through the fall. Davy continued to display mischievous habits, such as ruining Anne's lemon pies prepared for a visiting author and struggling with poor table manners. However, he also bonded with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), seeking her guidance with his bedtime prayers, overcoming jealous feelings, and sharing stories of his good deeds with her. Following the death of [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md), a trust fund was left for Davy and [Dora](../character/dora.md), allowing them to stay permanently at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P17](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0017), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P22](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0022), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P26](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0026), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P56](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0056), +26 more_

## Quotes

> “I . . . did something else today,” went on Davy in a muffled voice. “I’m sorry now but I’m awful scared to tell you. You won’t be very cross, will you? And you won’t tell Marilla, will you?”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P56](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0056)

> "I just did it for fun. Things have been so awful quiet here for so long that I thought it would be fun to give you folks a big scare. It was, too."
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P43](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0043)

> “I never will, now that I know it’s bad,” asseverated Davy between sobs. “If you ever catch me telling a whopper again you can . . .” Davy groped mentally for a suitable penance . . . “you can skin me alive, Anne.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P56](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0056)

> “Why?” queried Davy, settling comfortably down and looking up with a tearstained, investigating face. “Why ain’t whopper as good as falsehood? I want to know. It’s just as big a word.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P58](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0058)

> “Then,” said Davy decidedly, “Marilla is bad, for she tells them. And she’s worse’n me, for I didn’t know it was wrong but she does.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P68](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0068)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--davy-keith.md)

Davy looks up to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), taking her advice and even defending her picture from being drawn ugly. Though his mischievous nature leads to troublesome behavior, such as stealing food and lying to cover up locking his sister away, he confides in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when he misbehaves. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) patiently corrects his moral lapses, such as explaining the wrongness of lying and lecturing him on prayers, retaining a strong affection for him despite his antics.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P17](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0017), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P22](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0022), +16 more_

- Friend of — defends her picture from being drawn ugly and follows her advice  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P55](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0055), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P72](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0072)</sub>

### [Dora](../character/dora.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

[Dora](../character/dora.md) is Davy's twin sister. Davy frequently targets her with his mischievous behavior, such as snatching her cake at supper or locking her inside a toolhouse and lying about her whereabouts. Despite these incidents, they join in shared household activities and outings together, including rowboat rides.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +19 more_

- Sibling of — twin sister  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +7 more</sub>

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--marilla-cuthbert.md)

Davy lives under Marilla's household authority, where she disciplines his rambunctious antics by sending him to bed early or giving him stern lectures on good behavior. Davy occasionally plays pranks on her, such as hiding a toad in her bed, and challenges her credibility when he feels misled about prayers. Despite the constant trial of managing his bad habits, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) remains fond of him.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P17](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0017), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P22](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0022), +14 more_

- Serves under  <sub>[v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028)</sub>

### [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--milty-boulter.md)

Milty is Davy's friend, playmate, and seatmate at school. The two boys begin sharing a school desk when Davy starts his first days of education.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P8](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0008), +2 more_

- Friend of — seatmates and playmates at school  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001)</sub>
